## What's changed

- Level selection, its stage-clear return animation, and the records menu
  now use native 60 fps presentation. Your selected interpolation setting
  returns when you enter gameplay.
- **3-6: Chilly Dog!** and **3-7: Snowstorm Maze** stretch their mountain
  backdrop across widescreen, replacing the repeating square filler at the
  sides. Characters, terrain, and the snow layer keep their normal proportions.
- Source builds now verify the required RT64 patches during configuration
  and incremental builds. This prevents stale local renderer checkouts from
  silently reintroducing the previously fixed black right-edge strips and
  border trails. Official builds already applied those renderer patches.

## Validation

- Visually checked both snow-stage backgrounds.
- Verified native presentation and restoration of the selected frame-rate
  setting during a simulated stage-clear return.
- Compared 160 first-level captures at 144 fps before and after restoring
  the local renderer fixes: the black sky strip appeared in 9 frames before
  and none afterward.
- Added presentation tests for menu state selection, panorama clipping,
  texture coordinates, and tile joins at 16:10, 16:9, and 21:9.
- Added the presentation tests to Linux and Windows CI.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/ThiagoLira/trouble-makers-pc-recomp/compare/v0.8.1...v0.8.2
